meta.title: Lesson 8: Open the Python Notebook
meta.title_zh: 第 8 课：打开 Python 笔记本

study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: On Monday, I start the Python week. I open a notebook on my computer. A notebook lets me write code and see the result below it. I type a small line: print hello. The code runs, and I see the word hello. It feels simple, but I am happy.
segments.tts: On Monday, I start the Python week. I open a notebook on my computer. A notebook lets me write code and see the result below it. I type a small line: print hello. The code runs, and I see the word hello. It feels simple, but I am happy.
segments.zh: 周一我开始 Python 学习周。我在电脑上打开一个 notebook（笔记本）。它可以让我写代码，并在下面看到结果。我输入一行小代码 print hello，代码运行后，我看到了 hello。虽然简单，但我很开心。讲解：notebook=代码笔记本，run=运行，result=结果。

segments.en: I make a new folder for the project. I give it a clear name. Clear names help me find files later. I also write a short note about the goal: read a small data file. The goal is not big. A small goal is easier to finish.
segments.tts: I make a new folder for the project. I give it a clear name. Clear names help me find files later. I also write a short note about the goal: read a small data file. The goal is not big. A small goal is easier to finish.
segments.zh: 我为项目建了一个新文件夹，并给它起了清楚的名字。清楚的名字能帮助我以后找到文件。我还写下目标：读取一个小数据文件。目标不大，小目标更容易完成。讲解：folder=文件夹，clear=清楚的，goal=目标，finish=完成。

segments.en: Before I learn more commands, I save my work. I say the first sentence in English: I am learning Python one small step at a time. This sentence is easy, but it is useful. I read it aloud twice. English and code can grow together.
segments.tts: Before I learn more commands, I save my work. I say the first sentence in English: I am learning Python one small step at a time. This sentence is easy, but it is useful. I read it aloud twice. English and code can grow together.
segments.zh: 在学习更多命令前，我先保存工作。我用英语说：我一步一步学习 Python。这句话很简单，但很有用。我大声读了两遍。英语和代码可以一起进步。讲解：save=保存，aloud=大声地，grow together=一起成长。

chunks.eg: I open a notebook for the project.
Use a clear name for the file.
I learn Python one step at a time.
I save my work before I stop.

patterns.t: A small goal is easier to X.
I am learning X one step at a time.

transfer_tasks.task: Write 3 short sentences about starting a Python project. Use open a notebook, clear name, and save my work.
